sn46.21:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn46.21:2.2: kittāvatā nu kho bhante, bojjhaṅgāti vuccantīti.
sn46.21:2.3: bodhāya saṃvattantīti kho bhikkhu tasmā bojjhaṅgāti vuccanti.
sn46.21:2.5: upekhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn46.21:2.6: bodhāya saṃvattantīti kho bhikkhu tasmā bojjhaṅgāti vuccantīti.
